price_value.rationale: $17,500 sits inside the fair-value band (mid $16,206) but excludes wheels and tires, so the comparable complete truck is $19,000–$20,000, at the top of the band. Heavily modified builds trade below stock examples with records. The cracked dash and undocumented timing belt further reduce value.

mission_fit.rationale: A body-on-frame V8 GX does supply capability the RX lacks. However, this build (3in lift, 34s, sliders, skids, 'ready to wheel') exceeds the stated camping use, and the profile treats such hardware as no premium or a possible hard-use signal. The JW rack that suits a rooftop tent is excluded at $17,500.

logistics.rationale: Columbus, OH is roughly 2,400 miles from Carmel. Private seller, PPI access unstated. California registration needs smog, and the YotaWerx reflash may need a return to stock first.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: The parts are coherent and from quality brands (ICON, JW, SCS, ARB). But the buyer favours stock or mostly stock, and this is a fully built overland/off-road truck with aftermarket lights and grilles.

evidence.mission_note: A GX470 fits the capability branch, but this truck is an off-road build beyond the in-vehicle sleeping or rooftop-tent use described. The rack that would serve that use is excluded at the $17,500 price.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a heavily modified 2007 GX470 at a claimed 159k miles, with a detailed mileage-keyed maintenance list, but provides no VIN, no Carfax copy and no receipts. Everything is seller prose: the timing belt/water pump at 98k (61k miles ago, date unknown), the OEM radiator and hoses at 152k, and the fresh front-end work at 155k. Photos confirm the build: ICON lift stance, 34in matching all-terrains, JW rack and carrier, sliders, skids, aftermarket headlights. They also confirm trail use and a California plate consistent with the West Coast history claim. Observed issues are the disclosed cracked dash, the YotaWerx ECU/TCU tune (a California smog question), and a $17,500 price that excludes the wheels and tires shown. The complete truck is $19,000–$20,000, at the top of the $13,517–$19,729 fair-value band. Rear air-suspension status, frame condition, warning lights and PPI access remain open.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, the Carfax PDF, the wheel/tire configuration and date codes at $17,500, the timing-belt invoice, and frame/underbody photos, and ask whether he will allow an independent PPI in Columbus before any deposit.
